c0363613fc03.title_raw: Quantitative Research Internship - Quant Research/Trading - Starting Summer 2027
c0363613fc03.description_html:
About Wincent

We are a team of over 150 people, primarily Engineers, Traders and Quants, focused on HFT with ~1% of global crypto trading volume. Being a bit weird, we

  • Are self-taught; our founders do not come from any of the big HFTs

  • Chose to have no VCs on cap-table; this spot is for our colleagues

  • Made Bratislava the central hub, not London or Amsterdam

Culture

When you do something you love, it does not feel like work. At Wincent work is purposeful and fulfilling.

Integrity is not negotiable

Handshakes are sacred for us. Being in the money making business is good, but that alone is not worth our soul; we follow the motto “Be the good guys in the market”.

Say things as they are

Life is too short for games of politics, fluff, or bullshit in general.

Trust each other

We embrace internal radical transparency in terms of compensation, bonuses, and trading strategie

Quant Research/Trading Internship - Summer 2027 with Relocation Provided

Would you like to be paired with experienced traders who will teach you how to identify market signals, analyze and execute trading strategies, conduct statistical analysis, construct quantitative models, and enhance your trading intuition?

If you answered "YES," we've got something special for you: Join us as a Quantitative Research/Trading Intern on-site in Bratislava, Slovakia. We support European and UK citizens with accommodation & travel arrangements.

You'll dive into the exciting world of cryptocurrency trading, gain hands-on experience in quantitative analysis, algorithm development, and market research. As a Quant Intern, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, learn from experienced quant traders, and gain practical experience to get a head start on your trading career.

Working on projects alongside mentors will give you a sense of the variety of problems we solve every day. Throughout the summer, you'll also participate in simulated interactive mock trading sessions.

Apply today to join our Quantitative Research/Trading team.

About the Quant Research/Trading team

Our trading team digs into fresh trading ideas and tweaks the ones we already have. Most of our trading is fully automated, but we're not afraid to mix in some gut feeling or out-of-the-box ideas if they seem promising. A solid trader usually rocks a mix of strong technical skills (think stats and basic coding) and a good feel for probabilities and expected values.

What will you do in the Quant Research/Trading team

We’ve structured the program to be both fun and challenging, with a typical day including:

  • Morning betting games to get the day started.

  • Discussions on trading-related topics to deepen your understanding of market dynamics.

  • Work on practical exercises that mirror actual quant and trading tasks.

  • Time to explore your own ideas and projects, supported by our experienced team.

  • Play various games to enhance your trading intuition.

On top of that, you will:

  • Work with Python, Pandas, SQL, and Grafana for data analysis and real-time monitoring.

  • Learn trading fundamentals from experienced quants and traders.

  • Collaborate in teams to tackle challenging open-ended quant problems suitable for all levels, including beginners.

  • Participate in discussions about the problems to sharpen your argumentation skills.

  • Experience manual trading with substantial, yet manageable positions to grasp market dynamics.

What we expect from you

  • Love for games or betting.

  • Basic coding skills in Python or similar languages, with a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for cryptocurrency markets, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment.

On-site in Slovakia - RELOCATION PROVIDED

  • This internship opportunity is on-site in Bratislava, Slovakia, with relocation provided.

  • Internships are NOT open to remote work.

Interview process

  • Online Math test: Low-to-medium complexity problems focused on probability, logic, and mathematical skills. This is a take-home challenge that you can do anytime in your free time.

  • Quant Interview 45min: A set of medium complexity problems to assess your intuition and problem-solving approach.

  • Quant Interview 90min: General discussion about your background and passions, followed by medium-hard complexity problems to assess your intuition and problem-solving approach.

  • On-site Interview: Engage in a set of betting games to evaluate your quantitative reasoning and decision-making skills.

You'll conduct the final rounds on-site in Bratislava, Slovakia. All costs are covered and you'll get to know the team, city, and our venues.

Compensation and work arrangement

  • Full-day catering: All-inclusive breakfast, lunch, afternoon snacks, fruits, and other treats in our offices save you hundreds of euros every month.

  • Travel, Accommodation, and Visa Support: We'll help you cover the costs of joining us on-site.

  • Potential for Full-Time Transition: Exceptional interns may be considered for full-time positions based on their performance and our business needs.

  • Commitment: Full-time commitment for the duration of the seven-week summer 2027 internship.

  • On-site: Participation in our offices in Bratislava, Slovakia, is required to facilitate continuous interaction and learning with the team. We will support accommodation arrangements.

  • Onboarding: You will receive comprehensive training and guidance from our team, with introductory tasks designed to help you quickly grasp quantitative trading concepts and methodologies.

Why to choose Bratislava over other locations

  • Low living costs: Bratislava offers a significantly lower cost of living compared to most major European cities (source: Numbeo).

  • Low income tax: Slovakia offers only 25% personal income tax, compared to 55% Austria, 50% Belgium, 49% Netherlands, 48% Portugal, 47% Spain, 45% UK, France, and Germany, 44% Greece, and 40% Ireland according to taxsummaries.pwc.com.

  • Regional hub: Bratislava lies at the intersection of Austria (only 80km from Vienna), Czechia (130km from Brno), and Hungary (200km from Budapest).

  • Safety: Bratislava is one of the safest capitals in Europe, providing peace of mind that is harder to find in larger cities with higher crime rates, such as Paris, London, or Brussels.

  • High quality of life: Bratislava offers a balanced lifestyle with access to nature, excellent public amenities, and shorter commutes, unlike many larger cities where high living costs often compromise quality of life.

  • Booming economy and opportunities: Bratislava is a growing economic hub with a focus on technology, finance, and innovation, attracting international companies and startups.

Don't hesitate and apply today!

Working at Wincent 

At Wincent, we foster a culture of transparency, ownership, and autonomy, where every team member is empowered to make a meaningful impact. We prioritize clear objectives and give you the freedom to innovate and grow within a supportive, high-performing environment.

We value exceptional TOP 1% talent over a perfect match to a job description. If our vision and values resonate with you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to reach out—let’s explore how you can be part of shaping the future of cryptocurrency trading with us!

c0c90175cb40.title: Metallurgical Engineering Intern
c0c90175cb40.description_html:
Making the Metals Powering the World

Solcoa is building the next generation of American metalmaking, starting with rare earths — the metals of power and motion. We've developed a new chemistry that converts rare earth oxides into high-purity metals — the materials inside every EV, fighter jet, wind turbine, and data center — cleaner, cheaper, and faster than any conventional process. Now we're scaling it to thousands of tonnes of annual production.

The Role

Join our process team and help convert rare-earth oxides into high-purity metals. You’ll support reactor operations, run experiments and characterize feed materials and products, working with metallurgists, chemists and technicians to move from lab-scale experiments to repeatable production.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with high-temperature and high-vacuum reactor operations.

  • Help characterize feed materials and products using ICP-OES, SEM-EDS, LECO O/N.

  • Run furnace cycles, collect process data, and summarize results to inform design iterations.

  • Maintain organized logs of process parameters, equipment conditions, and sample tracking.

  • Support equipment maintenance: vacuum systems, induction coils, thermocouples, and gas handling.

  • Contribute to safety-first culture and continuous improvement on the facility floor.

What You Bring

Required

  • Pursuing a BS/MS in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.

  • Exposure to pyrometallurgy, electrometallurgy, or high-temperature processing (coursework or labs).

  • Hands-on experience from labs, foundry work, internships, or personal projects (furnaces, casting, heat treatment).

  • Detail-oriented, disciplined documentation, and reliable follow-through.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, hardware-centric environment and willing to get your hands dirty.

  • On-site availability; able to start soon.

Preferred

  • Experience with vacuum or inert-atmosphere furnace operation.

  • Familiarity with rare-earth metallurgy, molten salt electrolysis, or reactive metal processing.

  • Basic thermodynamic analysis skills (Ellingham diagrams, phase diagrams, FactSage/HSC a plus).

  • Welding or basic machining experience (mill/lathe).

  • Python/MATLAB for data analysis.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance.

  • Company-provided lunch daily.

  • J1 Visa sponsorship available if needed.

Are you ready to move your career forward and help shape our company’s and customers’ futures?

If you aspire to challenge yourself, work with the best in the industry and join a successful team where you can make a meaningful contribution, then we invite you to join us at Ketjen Corporation, a provider of advanced catalyst solutions to leading producers in the petrochemical, refining, and specialty chemicals industries. Together, we can create a legacy marked by innovation, excitement, and energy.

Ketjen is seeking rising sophomores and juniors to join our Summer 2026 Data Science Internship Program. The ideal candidate would be available to work full-time for 12 weeks from May 17, 2027 to August 6, 2027 at one of our sites in the Houston, TX area

Why choose to intern at Ketjen? We offer:

  • Competitive pay

  • Three vacation days and company holidays

  • Social engagement programs

  • Senior executive leadership networking opportunities

  • Corporate housing (for those who meet relocation criteria)

  • Full-time conversion opportunities

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Strong written and verbal communications skills 

  • Must be able to commit to a full-time schedule (40 hrs/week)

  • Prior industrial or manufacturing experience a plus 

  • Ability to participate in multiple Ketjen Internship or Co-Op sessions is a plus!

EDUCATION 

  • Seeking sophomore or junior level candidates (any graduation date between Dec 2027 to Dec 2029) 

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's degree from an ABET Accredited University majoring in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Analytics, or a similar discipline 

  • Cumulative GPA 3.0 or above on a 4.0 scale 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • JavaScript/JQuery

  • HTML/CSS

  • SQL Server/SSMS IDE

  • VBA within Excel

  • Python/Django via PyCharm Professional IDE

  • Azure DevOps for project tracking and code versioning (GIT)

Benefits of Joining Ketjen

  • Competitive compensation

  • Comprehensive benefits package

  • A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally.

Apply today and help Ketjen unleash the POTENTIAL of advanced chemistry for industries that power the world.
